sources.title: S16 [26.16] CHALLENGER QIYANA MID GUIDE - YT GUIDES AT END

passive.name: Royal Privilege
passive.text: Qiyana's first basic attack or ability against each enemy deals bonus damage.

spells.name: Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal
spells.text: Qiyana swings her weapon, dealing damage with a bonus effect based on her element.

spells.name: Terrashape
spells.text: Qiyana dashes to a location and enchants her weapon with an element. Her attacks and abilities deal bonus damage while her weapon is enchanted.

spells.name: Audacity
spells.text: Qiyana dashes to an enemy, damaging them.

spells.name: Supreme Display of Talent
spells.text: Qiyana sends out a shockwave that detonates whatever elements she hits with it, stunning and damaging nearby enemies.

damage.value: Qiyana deals burst damage with her first hit on each enemy, Q, E, and R, while an enchanted weapon adds damage to her attacks and abilities.

archetype.value: Qiyana is an assassin built around an assassin setup.

winCondition.value: Qiyana wins through fast combos and mechanical outplays.

spikes.at: When Qiyana enchants her weapon with W
spikes.why: Qiyana’s attacks and abilities gain bonus damage.

bait.why: Qiyana cannot use her stunning shockwave during its 120-second cooldown.

mistakes.value: Qiyana is difficult to learn as a first champion because she demands high mechanical skill.
